n=6

def solve_instance(row_sums, col_sums, diag_sums, timeout=10000):
    x=[[Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    s=Solver()
    s.set(timeout=timeout)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):

    s.add(Sum([x[i][i] for i in range(n)])==diag_sums[0])
    s.add(Sum([x[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n)])==diag_sums[1])
    # symmetry maybe x00 < x05? not safe? Can transpose/reverse? If sums assigned not invariant unless swap row order/col order/diags maybe. no
    res=s.check()
    print('check',res, row_sums, col_sums, diag_sums)
    if res==sat:
        m=s.model()
        grid=[[m.evaluate(x[i][j]).as_long() for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
        return grid
    return None

import random, math, time
n=6
lines=[]
# list cells index 0..35
for i in range(n): lines.append([i*n+j for j in range(n)])
for j in range(n): lines.append([i*n+j for i in range(n)])
lines.append([i*n+i for i in range(n)])
lines.append([i*n+(n-1-i) for i in range(n)])
cell_lines=[[] for _ in range(36)]
for li,line in enumerate(lines):
    for c in line: cell_lines[c].append(li)

def calc_sums(p):
    return [sum(p[c] for c in line) for line in lines]

def cost_from_sums(s):
    ss=sorted(s)
    best=10**9
    bestM=None
    for M in (104,105): # actually only possible
        # maybe square
        c=sum((ss[i]-(M+i))**2 for i in range(14))
        # duplicates/range covered by sorted match
        if c<best: best=c; bestM=M
    return best,bestM

def run(seed, max_iter=2000000):
    random.seed(seed)
    p=list(range(1,37)); random.shuffle(p)
    sums=calc_sums(p); cost,M=cost_from_sums(sums)
    best=(cost,p[:],sums[:])
    T0=5.0; Tend=0.01
    for it in range(max_iter):
        if cost==0:
            return p,sums,it
        a,b=random.sample(range(36),2)
        va,vb=p[a],p[b]; d=vb-va
        changed=set(cell_lines[a]+cell_lines[b])
        old=[sums[i] for i in changed]
        for li in cell_lines[a]: sums[li]+=d
        for li in cell_lines[b]: sums[li]-=d
        newcost,_=cost_from_sums(sums)
        delta=newcost-cost
        T=T0*((Tend/T0)**(it/max_iter))
        if delta<=0 or random.random()<math.exp(-delta/T):
            p[a],p[b]=p[b],p[a]; cost=newcost
            if cost<best[0]:
                best=(cost,p[:],sums[:])
                if cost<5: print('seed',seed,'it',it,'best',cost,sorted(sums), flush=True)
        else:
            # revert
            for li,val in zip(changed,old): sums[li]=val
    return None,best, max_iter

start=time.time()
for seed in range(20):
    print('starting',seed, 'time', time.time()-start, flush=True)
    res=run(seed, max_iter=1000000)
    if res[0] is not None:
        p,sums,it=res
        print('FOUND',seed,it)
        print(p)
        print(sums, sorted(sums))
        break
    else:
        print('not found best',res[1][0], sorted(res[1][2]))
print('elapsed',time.time()-start)
